scrap_broker.lovedLine: Now that — that has a buyer waiting, and he does not know it yet. {item} comes off your hands and onto my ledger, and we are both richer for it.
scrap_broker.likedLine: A fair piece, {item}. I'll not insult you with a low number for it.
scrap_broker.dislikeLine: I can move {item}, but I'd be holding it a season and paying to store it. That's not a gift, that's a lodger.
scrap_broker.politeLine: I'll take {item} off you and thank you for the thought. Every ledger has a line for kindness.
scrap_broker.insultLine: You carried {item} all this way to hand me? I price everything, friend, and that prices at nothing.
scrap_broker.returnGiftLine: Tellin slides something across without looking up. "Came through the pile. Thought of you. Don't make it strange."

order_scholar.lovedLine: You will forgive me if I sit down. {item} is the sort of thing the Order has written letters about for three generations without once holding, and I find my hands are not entirely steady.
order_scholar.likedLine: A useful instrument, {item}, and one I shall put to work before the week is out. My thanks, sincerely given.
order_scholar.dislikeLine: I do not doubt {item} has its uses. I doubt only that any of them occur inside a reading room.
order_scholar.politeLine: I accept {item} in the spirit it was offered, which is, I think, the larger part of any gift.
order_scholar.insultLine: I have catalogued the refuse of four ruined cities, and I would not have catalogued {item}. Take it back before I write it down.
order_scholar.returnGiftLine: Vesryn wraps it carefully before handing it over. "An instrument deserves hands that go somewhere. Yours do."

tartarian_quartermaster.lovedLine: Hm. {item}. Deep-work. You keep your hands where I can see them and I will keep this.
tartarian_quartermaster.dislikeLine: {item} is not for the dark. Down there it breaks, and then you break.
tartarian_quartermaster.insultLine: No. {item} is weight and nothing else. Carry your own weight.

wandering_drifter.lovedLine: Oh, that's a good day then. {item} is worth three nights of not being cold, and I have had my fill of being cold.
wandering_drifter.likedLine: {item}. That'll ride in the pack easy enough. My thanks.
wandering_drifter.dislikeLine: I walk everywhere I go, and {item} is somebody else's problem to carry.
wandering_drifter.politeLine: I'll find a use for {item} or I'll find someone who has one. Either way it doesn't go to waste.
wandering_drifter.insultLine: Depends on the day whether I take a thing like {item}. Today it doesn't. Today it doesn't at all.

thalan_wanderer.lovedLine: Well now, {item}! I'll tell you plain, friend, that's the sort of honest thing that keeps a man on the road and out of the ditch. You've made my whole week.
thalan_wanderer.likedLine: {item}, is it? Aye, that'll do nicely. The horse thanks you too, though she'll not say so.
thalan_wanderer.dislikeLine: I'll be honest with you, since honesty's cheaper than haggling — I've no earthly use for {item} out here on the roadside.
thalan_wanderer.politeLine: Kind of you. {item} goes in the pack, and I'll think well of you at the next outpost.
thalan_wanderer.insultLine: Friend. Friend. I have advised men on coin for twenty years and I am advising you now: {item} is worth nothing to anybody.

irma_ironhand.lovedLine: Hah! Look at the seam on {item} — whoever hammered that knew what a blow feels like from the inside. Give it here before you dent it.
irma_ironhand.likedLine: {item}. Sound enough. I'll not sneer at sound work.
irma_ironhand.dislikeLine: You bring {item} to a forge? What am I to do with it, season the coals?
irma_ironhand.politeLine: Aye, I'll have {item}. Not everything a smith keeps has to be struck.
irma_ironhand.insultLine: I put my mark on armor that outlives the man inside it. {item} would not outlive the walk home. Out.
irma_ironhand.returnGiftLine: Irma stops you at the counter and pushes a wrapped weight across it. "This batch came out better than the last. First one goes to you."

velar_shadowblade.lovedLine: Quiet. Don't hold {item} up like that. ...Where did you come by it? No — don't answer. That is exactly the right answer.
velar_shadowblade.likedLine: {item}. Serviceable. It will not get you seen, which is more than most gear can promise.
velar_shadowblade.dislikeLine: {item} announces you. I sell the opposite of announcing you.
velar_shadowblade.politeLine: I'll keep {item}. Not for the stall. For me. That is not an invitation to ask why.
velar_shadowblade.insultLine: You come into a market that isn't on any map and you offer me {item}? Go stand in the light where you belong.

jorah_scholar.lovedLine: Oh, my dear friend. {item} — sit, sit, you must let me read it before the light goes. There are students upstairs who will weep over this, and I shall let them.
jorah_scholar.likedLine: {item}! Yes, that has a place on my shelf and a place in the lending book. Thank you kindly.
jorah_scholar.dislikeLine: I teach children in this stall some mornings. I would rather not keep {item} where their hands can reach.
jorah_scholar.politeLine: A gift is a gift, and {item} shall be treated as one. You are welcome at my table whenever you pass.
jorah_scholar.insultLine: I have found wisdom in some very poor scraps, but there is none in {item}. Take it away, gently, and think no more of it.

elara_lightfinger.lovedLine: Ooh. Oh, you clever thing. {item} — small, quiet, and worth four times what the fellow two stalls down would guess. I like you enormously, and that is rare.
elara_lightfinger.likedLine: {item}, lovely. Goes in the tray at the front where the light catches it. It'll be gone by noon.
elara_lightfinger.dislikeLine: Darling, look at my stall. Look at my hands. Where in either of those does {item} fit?
elara_lightfinger.politeLine: That's sweet of you. {item} stays with me, and I'll say something nice about you to three people before supper.
elara_lightfinger.insultLine: I have picked better than {item} out of a gutter, and I say that with the gutter's full respect. Away with it.

halem_trader.lovedLine: Bless you for that. {item} is exactly what folk come asking for the morning after a bad night, and I hate turning them away empty.
halem_trader.likedLine: {item}, good. Somebody'll be glad of that before the month's out. My thanks.
halem_trader.dislikeLine: I'll not pretend, {item} isn't the sort of thing I keep. Village post, this. Bread and bandages.
halem_trader.politeLine: That's neighbourly of you. {item} goes behind the counter, and there's a bowl of something hot for you if you'll sit.
halem_trader.insultLine: I've sold to this village thirty years on an honest word, and my honest word is that {item} isn't worth the shelf it'd sit on.
halem_trader.returnGiftLine: Halem presses a warm crock into your hands before you can speak. "You feed my curiosity often enough. Eat."

tarek_tinkerer.lovedLine: No. NO. Is that — it is! {item}, and the housing's intact! Move the kettle, move the kettle, I need the whole bench for this.
tarek_tinkerer.likedLine: {item}! Good, good, that goes in the third crate, the one that hums. Don't ask about the humming.
tarek_tinkerer.dislikeLine: It has no moving parts, friend. {item} does nothing. I cannot take apart a thing that does nothing.
tarek_tinkerer.politeLine: I'll take {item}. Everything's a component if you're patient and slightly reckless, and I am both.
tarek_tinkerer.insultLine: I have built three things out of rubbish this week and I still could not build anything out of {item}. Get it off the bench.
tarek_tinkerer.returnGiftLine: Tarek shoves it at you, already talking. "Doesn't work. Well — doesn't work YET. You'll figure it out, that's why I'm giving it to you."

felra_swiftfoot.lovedLine: Oh, feel that sole! {item} — I could cross a gallery of sleeping guards in these and none of them would roll over. You've a good eye, and I'll not forget it.
felra_swiftfoot.likedLine: {item}. That's honest footwear. Half of staying alive is where you put your feet, you know.
felra_swiftfoot.dislikeLine: Bless you, but {item} is all noise and burden. You'd hear yourself coming from the far end of the camp.
felra_swiftfoot.politeLine: I'll take {item} kindly. Come back when your soles wear thin and I'll see you right.
felra_swiftfoot.insultLine: I've stitched boots from worse than {item}, but I've never been paid in it. Off with you, quietly.

korr_stonefoot.lovedLine: You bring me {item}. Both hands to hold it. That is a thing worth holding. I will remember your face now, and that takes most men a year.
korr_stonefoot.likedLine: {item}. Heavy in the right places. Set it down there.
korr_stonefoot.dislikeLine: {item} is for a man who wants the fight over before it starts. I do not trust that man, and I do not trust his tools.
korr_stonefoot.politeLine: Kept. {item} will sit by the wall. I do not throw away what was given.
korr_stonefoot.insultLine: I lift stone for a living. I am not lifting {item}. Take it and go slow.

cassia_nightwind.lovedLine: Draw it. Go on — feel where it stacks. {item} was made by someone who has actually missed a shot and minded about it. I'll take good care of it. Better than you would.
cassia_nightwind.likedLine: {item}. That will fly true enough. Thank you — I do mean it, I simply say it quietly.
cassia_nightwind.dislikeLine: You'd have to be close enough to smell them to use {item}. I prefer the distance. I always have.
cassia_nightwind.politeLine: I'll keep {item}. Not everything I keep is for shooting with.
cassia_nightwind.insultLine: I have loosed arrows at things I could barely see, and I would not waste one on whatever {item} is. No.

odar_flameforge.lovedLine: HAH! Everyone, hands down, look here — {item}, in my forge, on this day! I have wanted this since I was an apprentice with singed eyebrows. You are a friend of the flame and I will say so loudly!
odar_flameforge.likedLine: {item}! Good stuff, good stuff. It will see the fire before the week's out, and it will come out better.
odar_flameforge.dislikeLine: You bring cold to a fire-forge? {item} would crack the moment my coals looked at it.
odar_flameforge.politeLine: I'll have {item}, and I'll shout your name across the yard for it. That is how I say thank you and you'll not talk me out of it.
odar_flameforge.insultLine: I have burned better than {item} for kindling and been ashamed of the kindling! Away!
odar_flameforge.returnGiftLine: Odar sets a sealed pot in front of you. "Burns hotter than what I sell. You've earned the good batch."

silvan_the_quiet.lovedLine: ...Yes. Do you hear it? {item} is still singing. Very few things still sing. I will not thank you loudly, but I will thank you for a long time.
silvan_the_quiet.likedLine: {item}. It has a little light left in it. That is enough.
silvan_the_quiet.dislikeLine: {item} is silent. Not quiet — silent. There is a difference, and I deal only in the one.
silvan_the_quiet.politeLine: I accept {item}. Set it there, by the lamp. I keep more than I sell.
silvan_the_quiet.insultLine: No. {item} has nothing in it and never did. Please take it out of the room.

bran_the_beastmaster.lovedLine: Ha! Look at her ears go up — she knew before I did! {item} is the finest thing anyone's put in my hands all season, and she'll be insufferable about it for a week.
bran_the_beastmaster.likedLine: {item}, aye, that's a good bit of kit. There's a beast on this road that'll be warmer for it tonight.
bran_the_beastmaster.dislikeLine: I'll not have {item} near the pens. Whatever's in it, they can smell it, and they don't like it.
bran_the_beastmaster.politeLine: Kind of you! {item} goes in the wagon. Come see the hounds before you head off, they've decided they like you.
bran_the_beastmaster.insultLine: I've fed my dogs things I'd not name in company, and even they'd turn their nose from {item}. Take it off, please.
bran_the_beastmaster.returnGiftLine: Bran tosses it to you underhand. "For the dog. Or for you — I don't judge either way."

vela_ironheart.lovedLine: Stand still. Let me see the edge properly. ...{item} was made by a disciplined hand, and a disciplined hand deserves a straight word: this is excellent, and I am in your debt.
vela_ironheart.likedLine: {item}. Well kept. That tells me more about you than anything you've said.
vela_ironheart.dislikeLine: {item} kills a man without ever meeting him. I have no discipline to teach with a thing like that.
vela_ironheart.politeLine: I accept {item}, and I will not pretend to more enthusiasm than I have. The courtesy is noted regardless.
vela_ironheart.insultLine: You would carry {item} into a fight and expect to walk out. That is not courage, it is arithmetic you have not done. Take it back.

mara_stoneskin.lovedLine: Come nearer to the fire, you've earned it. {item} — stone that remembers being under the world. I do not warm to people quickly, and you have just made it quick.
mara_stoneskin.likedLine: {item}. Solid. I'll set it where the damp won't reach. Sit a while if you like.
mara_stoneskin.dislikeLine: {item} won't stand against a rockfall or a golem's fist, and out here it's one or the other by Tuesday.
mara_stoneskin.politeLine: I'll take {item}, and thank you for it, though I'll not pretend I know what I'll do with it yet.
mara_stoneskin.insultLine: I was warm with you and you brought me {item}. That is how a person learns not to be warm. Go on.

yara_windcaller.lovedLine: Hold it loosely. There — do you feel how it wants to move? {item} was made for someone who understands that going quickly is a kind of stillness. Thank you. Truly.
yara_windcaller.likedLine: {item}. Light in the hand. That is most of what I ask of anything.
yara_windcaller.dislikeLine: {item} would hold me to the ground, and I have spent a great deal of my life learning not to be held.
yara_windcaller.politeLine: I will keep {item}, and I will not hurry to decide what for. Some things take their own time.
yara_windcaller.insultLine: I am patient with most things. Not with {item}. Carry it back the way you came, slowly.
yara_windcaller.returnGiftLine: Yara holds it out on an open palm, like something the wind left. "It wanted to go to you. Who am I to argue."

zorin_nightblade.lovedLine: ...Ah. Someone died badly to make {item}, and someone else died badly carrying it. Both of them would be furious to see it in my hands. Good.
zorin_nightblade.likedLine: {item}. It has been used. I prefer things that have been used.
zorin_nightblade.dislikeLine: Everyone owns {item}. I do not sell what everyone owns.
zorin_nightblade.politeLine: It stays with me. I will not say I wanted {item}, but I will say nothing against it either.
zorin_nightblade.insultLine: You have brought {item} to a man who trades in the last thing people ever hold. Reconsider your errand.

kirin_spellweaver.lovedLine: Ah. Set {item} down and step back a pace — not from danger, from courtesy. A shaped thing should be allowed to settle. This is a considerable gift, and I will not waste it.
kirin_spellweaver.likedLine: {item}. Well made, and made with intent. Those are not the same, and I value the second more.
kirin_spellweaver.dislikeLine: There is no thought in {item}. It does what it does and never asks why. I find I cannot love such things.
kirin_spellweaver.politeLine: I accept {item}. Every object teaches something, even if only patience.
kirin_spellweaver.insultLine: You offer {item} to a weaver of runes. There is nothing in it to weave. Take it, and think a little longer next time.

drakos_mercenary.lovedLine: Ha! Both hands, look — both hands and it still wants more! {item} was forged for a man who intends to end things. Drink with me, you have excellent taste.
drakos_mercenary.likedLine: {item}. It swings. That is the whole of my requirement and it meets it.
drakos_mercenary.dislikeLine: What am I to do with {item}, tickle them? I am paid by the finished job, not the clever one.
drakos_mercenary.politeLine: Fine, fine, I'll take {item}. I'll not use it, but I'll take it, and I'll say you dealt fair.
drakos_mercenary.insultLine: I have broken shields with my knee. I will not be handed {item} and told it is a gift. Take it out of my sight.

nalren_frostgrip.lovedLine: Do not breathe on it. {item} holds its cold better than most men hold their nerve. You have done well. I will not say it twice.
nalren_frostgrip.likedLine: {item}. It will keep. Everything worth having keeps.
nalren_frostgrip.dislikeLine: Heat is a short argument, and {item} makes it badly. Cold outlasts. Cold always outlasts.
nalren_frostgrip.politeLine: It is taken. {item} will go in the back, with the rest of what I do not need.
nalren_frostgrip.insultLine: You have walked a cold road to hand me {item}. That was the only cold thing about this transaction. No.

monarch_agent.lovedLine: Hood up. Walk with me. {item} does not exist, you never held it, and there are tokens in your hand with no marks on them. We understand each other.
monarch_agent.likedLine: {item}. Useful. It goes in the coat, not the ledger.
monarch_agent.dislikeLine: {item} is loud, and loud is a debt somebody eventually collects. Not from me.
monarch_agent.politeLine: Taken. You were never here, and {item} was never given.
monarch_agent.insultLine: You are being remembered right now, and for {item}. That is the worst trade you will make today.

servants_quartermaster.lovedLine: The stone at my throat has not gone quiet since you came up the road. {item}. Kneel or don't, but be still a moment — this was theirs, and it is only lent to us.
servants_quartermaster.likedLine: {item}. A small mercy, honestly come by. I will say a word over it before it goes on the shelf.
servants_quartermaster.dislikeLine: {item} was pried off the sleeping, and the pryer said no prayer. I will not put it beside things that were given.
servants_quartermaster.politeLine: It is received, and blessed, such as my blessing is worth. {item} will not be wasted here.
servants_quartermaster.insultLine: I sell nothing without a prayer first, and I can find no prayer for {item}. Look at me. Take it away.

dynasty_factor.lovedLine: You may consider this audience extended. {item} belongs to a line that does not end, and you have returned it to that line. The Dynasty notices such things, and the Dynasty's memory is long past your reckoning.
dynasty_factor.likedLine: Acceptable. {item} has the look of proper workmanship, which is rarer each year among the brief-lived.
dynasty_factor.dislikeLine: One does not present {item} at court, and this stall is a court, whatever the roof over it looks like.
dynasty_factor.politeLine: It is received. {item} shall be recorded, filed, and, in all likelihood, outlast you.
dynasty_factor.insultLine: You have offered {item} to the house that predates your grandmother's grandmother. The audience is concluded.

architects_keeper.lovedLine: ...Two doors on this that I have only heard rumoured. Somebody drew {item} who was not supposed to be in the room. I would very much like to know if they are still alive, and I would very much like you not to tell me.
architects_keeper.likedLine: {item}. Quiet, and it does not draw an eye. Both of those are the whole job.
architects_keeper.dislikeLine: {item} makes a noise, and a noise is a witness. I do not keep witnesses.
architects_keeper.politeLine: A nod, then. {item} goes where things go. You'll not see it again, and that is the point.
architects_keeper.insultLine: There are three exits in this room and you have spent your only visit offering me {item}. Use the nearest one.

builders_foreman.lovedLine: Now that will hold weight. {item} — you could hang a course of stone off that and go home to your supper without a thought. I'll tell you plain, lad, that's the best thing anyone's handed me this year.
builders_foreman.likedLine: {item}. Sound. Not clever, mind, but sound, and sound builds walls.
builders_foreman.dislikeLine: Put a load on {item} and it folds. I've buried men who trusted things that fold.
builders_foreman.politeLine: I'll take it, and I'll say thank you, and I'll not pretend {item} will ever see a work site.
builders_foreman.insultLine: I sell gear built to outlast its owner. {item} wouldn't outlast the walk to the gate. Take it and don't do that again.

revivalists_quartermaster.lovedLine: Do you feel it? Put your hand here, on the coil — it answers {item}! The buried world is not dead, friend, it is only sleeping, and you have just made it turn over in its sleep.
revivalists_quartermaster.likedLine: {item}! Every piece we gather is a piece the world gets back. Believer's discount for you, and gladly.
revivalists_quartermaster.dislikeLine: There is no current in {item}. It cannot wake anything, least of all a world.
revivalists_quartermaster.politeLine: I'll take {item} and I'll thank you, though I'd thank you more if you'd stay and hear the creed.
revivalists_quartermaster.insultLine: The world beneath us is stirring and you have brought me {item}. Hear the creed, or go — but take that with you.
revivalists_quartermaster.returnGiftLine: The quartermaster sets the kit down between you, official as a requisition. "Logged as damaged stock. It isn't. Take it."

roadside:grit_maalen.lovedLine: Now that's a proper {item}. You'll sit and eat with me before you go, and I'll not hear otherwise.
roadside:grit_maalen.likedLine: A {item}. Honest thing, honestly given. My thanks.
roadside:grit_maalen.dislikeLine: I'll take the {item} off your hands, but I've no use for it and I'll not pretend I do.
roadside:grit_maalen.politeLine: That's a {item}, right enough. Kind of you.
roadside:grit_maalen.insultLine: You carried a {item} all this way to hand me? Keep it. Keep your breath too.

roadside:sena_ropewalk.lovedLine: Good line, this {item}. Braided true, no rot in the core. That's a gift that holds a body over a drop.
roadside:sena_ropewalk.likedLine: A {item}. I'll find work for it before the week's out.
roadside:sena_ropewalk.dislikeLine: The {item}? It won't take a knot and it won't take weight. Still, thank you.
roadside:sena_ropewalk.insultLine: I've spliced rope with more worth than that {item}. Don't waste my hands with it.

roadside:ovik_the_patient.lovedLine: A {item}. Sit. It keeps better warm and it keeps better shared, and I have all evening.
roadside:ovik_the_patient.likedLine: The {item} is welcome. Slow things are the good things.
roadside:ovik_the_patient.dislikeLine: I'll set the {item} at the back of the cart. Everything finds its hour, I suppose.
roadside:ovik_the_patient.politeLine: A {item}. I thank you for the thought, traveller.
roadside:ovik_the_patient.insultLine: I have waited out three winters at this stall. I will not spend a moment of the fourth on a {item}.

roadside:talla_mudfoot.lovedLine: Look at the sole on that {item}. Twenty leagues of wet clay in it and not a complaint. You've done me a kindness.
roadside:talla_mudfoot.likedLine: A {item}. My feet have been the whole of my fortune, and they thank you.
roadside:talla_mudfoot.dislikeLine: Fine thing, the {item}, but it won't carry me anywhere. I walk. That's all I do.
roadside:talla_mudfoot.politeLine: A {item}, is it. Good of you.
roadside:talla_mudfoot.insultLine: I've scraped better than that {item} off my heel at a ford crossing.

roadside:bersk_cartwright.lovedLine: A {item} with a true edge and a true weight. My axle's been groaning since Thametan road. This mends it.
roadside:bersk_cartwright.likedLine: The {item} will earn its place in the box. I don't keep what doesn't work.
roadside:bersk_cartwright.dislikeLine: I've no hands for a {item}. I fix wheels, not weather.
roadside:bersk_cartwright.politeLine: A {item}. I'll take it, and thank you.
roadside:bersk_cartwright.insultLine: Bring me a {item} again and I'll charge you for the time it took to look at it.

roadside:nell_of_the_long_road.lovedLine: A {item}. I have walked every road on it but two, and now I'll walk those. That is the best thing anyone has handed me this season.
roadside:nell_of_the_long_road.likedLine: The {item} suits a long walker. I'll carry it as far as it wants to go.
roadside:nell_of_the_long_road.dislikeLine: The {item} is heavy and the road is long. One of those I can change.
roadside:nell_of_the_long_road.insultLine: I've come from the far spires on foot. Do not meet me at the end of it with a {item}.

roadside:duvo_saltbeard.lovedLine: Salt, smoke and time — that's all a {item} is, and all a man needs. You know your keeping, friend.
roadside:duvo_saltbeard.likedLine: A {item}. It'll go in the barrel and come out better for the waiting.
roadside:duvo_saltbeard.dislikeLine: The {item} will spoil before the next crossroads. I deal in what lasts.
roadside:duvo_saltbeard.politeLine: A {item}. Salt in your beard and luck on your road.
roadside:duvo_saltbeard.insultLine: I've cured meat older than that {item} and better company besides.

roadside:riska_panhandle.lovedLine: A {item}! Do you know what a body walks to find one of these? Ditches, mostly. You've saved me the ditches.
roadside:riska_panhandle.likedLine: The {item} is a good find. The ground gives up little and asks a lot.
roadside:riska_panhandle.dislikeLine: The {item} never grew anywhere. I don't know what to do with a thing that never grew.
roadside:riska_panhandle.politeLine: A {item}. That's kind, and I'll say so plain.
roadside:riska_panhandle.insultLine: I could have panhandled a better gift out of a wet ditch than that {item}.

roadside:ymer_tinpot.lovedLine: Hear that? Struck the {item} and it rang true. Metal that rings is metal that mends, and I've three pots waiting.
roadside:ymer_tinpot.likedLine: A {item}. Into the tin box with it. Everything goes in the tin box.
roadside:ymer_tinpot.dislikeLine: The {item} won't take a rivet nor a solder. Soft goods are somebody else's trade.
roadside:ymer_tinpot.insultLine: I hammer scrap for my supper and even I would not stoop for that {item}.

roadside:halda_roadsworn.lovedLine: An oath in metal, this {item}. I gave my word to this road when I was young, and I keep such things. It will hang where I can see it.
roadside:halda_roadsworn.likedLine: A {item}. Kept things are kept promises. I'll not lose it.
roadside:halda_roadsworn.dislikeLine: The {item} carries no name and swears to nothing. I'd rather a thing that means something.
roadside:halda_roadsworn.politeLine: A {item}. My thanks, and my word you'll get honest weight from me.
roadside:halda_roadsworn.insultLine: I am roadsworn, not roadsold. Take your {item} and your poor opinion elsewhere.

roadside:pell_the_slow.lovedLine: Ah. Give me a moment with this {item}. Good stitching wants looking at. My hands crack in the cold and these will see me to spring.
roadside:pell_the_slow.likedLine: A {item}. That's... yes. That's good. Thank you.
roadside:pell_the_slow.dislikeLine: The {item} moves faster than I care to. I've never been quick and I've never needed to be.
roadside:pell_the_slow.politeLine: A {item}. Slow thanks, but true ones.
roadside:pell_the_slow.insultLine: I am slow, friend, not simple. Take the {item} back before I find my temper.

roadside:vosk_barrowman.lovedLine: Heft on that {item}. I've hauled this barrow from the low fields since I could walk, and a good weight is an honest friend.
roadside:vosk_barrowman.likedLine: The {item} goes in the barrow. Barrow's never yet complained.
roadside:vosk_barrowman.dislikeLine: The {item} does nothing you can put your back into. I don't trust what I can't lift.
roadside:vosk_barrowman.politeLine: A {item}. Good, that. Thanks to you.
roadside:vosk_barrowman.insultLine: I push a barrow uphill for a living and that {item} is still the heaviest thing you've handed me.

roadside:skiv.lovedLine: Short. Quiet. Goes in a boot. A {item} like that never has to be explained to anyone.
roadside:skiv.dislikeLine: Can't hide a {item}. Can't run with it. No.
roadside:skiv.politeLine: The {item}. Right. Under the cloth it goes.
roadside:skiv.insultLine: Don't stand at my cart holding a {item} like it's worth words.

roadside:marlow_quicksleeve.lovedLine: Small. Round. Fits a sleeve without a shape showing. A {item} is the whole of my trade in one hand.
roadside:marlow_quicksleeve.likedLine: A {item}. That'll go quiet enough. No questions from either of us.
roadside:marlow_quicksleeve.dislikeLine: A {item} doesn't fit anywhere it needs to fit. I'd be carrying it in the open like a fool.
roadside:marlow_quicksleeve.politeLine: The {item}. Gone. Where? Don't ask, and I'll say thank you.
roadside:marlow_quicksleeve.insultLine: Nobody has ever pinched a {item}, and now I understand why.

roadside:ret_the_ash.lovedLine: Burns clean, a {item}. No stall left, no ledger left, no one left asking where the stall went.
roadside:ret_the_ash.likedLine: A {item}. It'll take to a blade well enough.
roadside:ret_the_ash.dislikeLine: The {item} puts things back together. That is not the direction I work in.
roadside:ret_the_ash.politeLine: The {item}. Set it down. Don't set it down hard.
roadside:ret_the_ash.insultLine: I have burned better than that {item} for warmth, and I did not stay warm.

roadside:onda_blackpalm.lovedLine: See how it sits still in the glass? A {item} does not shout. Nothing I sell shouts.
roadside:onda_blackpalm.likedLine: A {item}. It'll thin down into three vials, maybe four.
roadside:onda_blackpalm.dislikeLine: The {item} keeps people upright. I have no customers for that.
roadside:onda_blackpalm.politeLine: The {item}. Don't touch the palm when you hand it over.
roadside:onda_blackpalm.insultLine: I have milked worse things than you out of nastier holes than this. Take the {item} with you.

roadside:wysh_coincatcher.lovedLine: Ah. Now that has a price with a comma in it. A {item} pays for the cart, the road, and the silence after.
roadside:wysh_coincatcher.likedLine: A {item}. I can move that in two towns. Three, if the weather turns.
roadside:wysh_coincatcher.dislikeLine: The {item} won't fetch coin and I don't deal in what won't fetch coin.
roadside:wysh_coincatcher.politeLine: The {item}. Weighed, noted, taken. We're square.
roadside:wysh_coincatcher.insultLine: You could not buy a cup of ditchwater with that {item}. Nor my patience.

roadside:dral_hollowpocket.lovedLine: There's a false bottom in everything if you know where to press. A {item} is a hole you can carry, and I like holes.
roadside:dral_hollowpocket.likedLine: A {item}. It'll disappear into the lining nicely.
roadside:dral_hollowpocket.dislikeLine: The {item} won't go in a pocket, hollow or otherwise. That's the whole of my objection.
roadside:dral_hollowpocket.politeLine: The {item}. It's already gone. Don't look for it.
roadside:dral_hollowpocket.insultLine: My pockets are hollow, friend, not hungry. That {item} stays with you.

roadside:teska_nightweigh.lovedLine: On the pan it goes. There — see the needle settle? A {item} weighs whatever I say it weighs, and tonight I am generous.
roadside:teska_nightweigh.likedLine: A {item}. Two ounces. Call it two ounces.
roadside:teska_nightweigh.dislikeLine: The {item} won't sit right on a pan. I only trade in what I can weigh, and weigh twice.
roadside:teska_nightweigh.politeLine: The {item}. Noted at the night rate. That's the rate I have.
roadside:teska_nightweigh.insultLine: I keep a crooked scale and even a crooked scale will not lie for that {item}.

roadside:grum_the_fence.lovedLine: Somebody wants a {item} back. Somebody always wants a {item} back. That's why it pays.
roadside:grum_the_fence.likedLine: A {item}. I know three doors it fits behind. Say no more than that.
roadside:grum_the_fence.dislikeLine: Nobody's looking for a {item}, so nobody's paying for one. Simple trade, that.
roadside:grum_the_fence.politeLine: The {item}. Off the road, under the cart, out of the county by morning.
roadside:grum_the_fence.insultLine: I move stolen crowns. I do not move a {item}. Nobody moves a {item}.

roadside:ilva_sidelong.lovedLine: A face that isn't mine. Do you know the price of that? A {item} lets me stand in a market I've been chased out of twice.
roadside:ilva_sidelong.likedLine: A {item}. Good. Nobody looks twice at what they can't see.
roadside:ilva_sidelong.dislikeLine: The {item} throws light. I have made a life of not being in any.
roadside:ilva_sidelong.politeLine: The {item}. Fine. I'll not be looking at you when I take it.
roadside:ilva_sidelong.insultLine: You watched me sidelong for an hour to hand over a {item}. Watch the road instead.

roadside:norrick_pryce.lovedLine: Hold still. Through the glass a {item} shows its true make, and its true make is worth four times what the last fool told you.
roadside:norrick_pryce.likedLine: A {item}. I'll price it properly, which is to say low, and you'll thank me for it.
roadside:norrick_pryce.dislikeLine: I've priced a {item} before. The price was nothing. It has not moved since.
roadside:norrick_pryce.politeLine: The {item}. Marked down in the book. My book, my figure.
roadside:norrick_pryce.insultLine: Every article has a price. A {item} has an insult, and you have just delivered it.

roadside:bek_whisperlot.lovedLine: Lean in. A {item} says a name, and a name is the only stock worth the cart. Don't repeat what you heard.
roadside:bek_whisperlot.likedLine: A {item}. Someone's secret in it somewhere. There always is.
roadside:bek_whisperlot.dislikeLine: The {item} makes noise and says nothing. I trade the opposite.
roadside:bek_whisperlot.politeLine: The {item}. Quietly. Everything here goes quietly.
roadside:bek_whisperlot.insultLine: Whisper it or don't, a {item} is worthless in any voice.

roadside:zann_of_no_fixed_stall.lovedLine: Light enough to run with. That's the only question I ask of anything, and a {item} answers it right.
roadside:zann_of_no_fixed_stall.likedLine: A {item}. Small. Good. I'm three streets from here by dusk.
roadside:zann_of_no_fixed_stall.dislikeLine: I'd have to leave the {item} behind the first time somebody shouted. So I'll not pick it up.
roadside:zann_of_no_fixed_stall.politeLine: The {item}. Taken. This stall was never here.
roadside:zann_of_no_fixed_stall.insultLine: I own nothing and go nowhere twice, and I still would not carry a {item} one street.

roadside_honest.lovedLine: A {item}, and freely given. That's rarer on this road than you'd think. You'll get honest weight from me forever.
roadside_honest.likedLine: The {item} is welcome. Plain thanks, plainly meant.
roadside_honest.dislikeLine: I'll take the {item}, but I'd not have picked it up myself.
roadside_honest.insultLine: I trade fair and I speak fair, so hear it fair: that {item} is an insult.

roadside_sketchy.lovedLine: That's a {item} nobody will come asking after. Under the cloth. We never spoke.
roadside_sketchy.likedLine: A {item}. It'll move. Don't stand about while it does.
roadside_sketchy.dislikeLine: Nobody buys a {item} and nobody steals one. Says everything.
roadside_sketchy.politeLine: The {item}. Fine. Step back from the cart.
roadside_sketchy.insultLine: I fence stolen crowns and drowned relics. Take your {item} and take the road.

hidden_market_weapons.lovedLine: Let me see the edge on it. A {item} like this does not come down the stair twice in a season — name your favour, it is owed.
hidden_market_weapons.likedLine: A {item}. Serviceable. There is always a hand looking for one of those.
hidden_market_weapons.dislikeLine: This is an arms stall. A {item} will not cut, throw, or fire, and so it is nothing to me.
hidden_market_weapons.politeLine: A {item}. It goes under the counter with the odd stock. Obliged.
hidden_market_weapons.insultLine: A {item}? I trade in killing gear. Take that up the stair and do not come back down with it.

hidden_market_armor.lovedLine: Look at the seating on those plates. A {item} of this make keeps a body whole, and whole bodies are what I sell.
hidden_market_armor.likedLine: A {item}. It will turn a blow, and turning one blow is a whole life sometimes.
hidden_market_armor.dislikeLine: A {item} covers nothing. I fit people against the world; that will not fit against anything.
hidden_market_armor.politeLine: A {item}. Hang it on the rail there. My thanks.
hidden_market_armor.insultLine: I plate the living, and you hand me a {item}. Go and be someone else's custom.

hidden_market_food.lovedLine: A {item}. There is no daylight down here and no fields either — you have brought something living into a hole in the ground.
hidden_market_food.likedLine: A {item} will keep. Anything that keeps has a place on my board.
hidden_market_food.dislikeLine: I feed people from this table. A {item} does not go near it.
hidden_market_food.politeLine: A {item}. I'll find a shelf for it. Eat something before you go.
hidden_market_food.insultLine: You hand a {item} across a victualler's counter. Get out of my stall before I remember your face.

hidden_market_materials.lovedLine: Set it down gently. A {item} of that grade goes into three trades before it stops moving, and every one of them profits.
hidden_market_materials.likedLine: A {item}. Raw stock, but honest stock. I can work with honest stock.
hidden_market_materials.dislikeLine: A {item} is not a material. It is a thing that has already finished being useful.
hidden_market_materials.politeLine: A {item}. In the crate. I'll sort the crate on a slow day.
hidden_market_materials.insultLine: A {item}, offered seriously, to a materials broker. You have wasted a walk down a very long stair.

overlay:olek_the_ledger_keeper.lovedLine: A {item} — sealed, countable, and belonging to nobody at present. That is the finest condition an object can be in. I shall enter it twice, for the pleasure.
overlay:olek_the_ledger_keeper.likedLine: A {item}. I can put a figure to that, and a figure is a kind of company up here.
overlay:olek_the_ledger_keeper.dislikeLine: Take the {item} back. I balance columns, not brawls, and I would rather not be found holding it.
overlay:olek_the_ledger_keeper.politeLine: A {item}. Received. Recorded. I keep everything recorded; it is how the trouble started.
overlay:olek_the_ledger_keeper.insultLine: A {item}. I have audited barns with more in them than this. Down the ladder with you.

overlay:sister_yelena_of_the_tall_air.lovedLine: A {item}. Three years of wind and it has said nothing I could act upon — but this hums, brother, this hums. Perhaps I have been listening at the wrong height.
overlay:sister_yelena_of_the_tall_air.likedLine: A {item} is welcome. There is little enough up here that was made by hands.
overlay:sister_yelena_of_the_tall_air.dislikeLine: A {item} would drown the air. I did not climb a spire to be shouted at.
overlay:sister_yelena_of_the_tall_air.politeLine: A {item}. I shall lash it to the rail with the rest. Everything must be lashed to the rail.
overlay:sister_yelena_of_the_tall_air.insultLine: I gave up the ground for the Giants' voices, and you hand up a {item}. Go down. Mind the third bracket, it is loose.

overlay:adept_ireneus_of_the_catalogue.lovedLine: A {item} — and observe, if you will, that it is entry nine hundred and something in a work of fifty years, of which I have completed three, which is to say I am precisely on schedule. Extraordinary. Extraordinary.
overlay:adept_ireneus_of_the_catalogue.likedLine: A {item}. I shall want a full description of where it was standing when you found it, but yes, this is admissible.
overlay:adept_ireneus_of_the_catalogue.dislikeLine: A {item} cannot be catalogued. It has no provenance, no measure, and no top from which to survey it.
overlay:adept_ireneus_of_the_catalogue.politeLine: A {item}. It will be given a number. Everything is given a number eventually.
overlay:adept_ireneus_of_the_catalogue.insultLine: You have carried a {item} up nine hundred feet of spire to a scholar of the Forgotten Order. I shall record that too, under follies.

overlay:mikola_the_lost_on_purpose.lovedLine: A {item}! Now that is a thing a man can be nowhere in particular with, comfortably. I will trade you anything on this ledge and I will not remember the price.
overlay:mikola_the_lost_on_purpose.likedLine: A {item}, is it? Good. Useful. I like a thing that does not ask me where I am going.
overlay:mikola_the_lost_on_purpose.dislikeLine: No, no — a {item} would tell me where I am. That is the one thing I have managed to avoid up here.
overlay:mikola_the_lost_on_purpose.politeLine: A {item}. Lovely. It goes in the pile. The pile is also lovely.
overlay:mikola_the_lost_on_purpose.insultLine: I climbed up here on a bet I cannot recall, and even I know a {item} is not worth the carrying. Off you go — down is that way, probably.

wanderer:traveler.lovedLine: A {item}. Friend, I have counted every mile behind me and I will count this one differently. That is no small gift to give a walking man.
wanderer:traveler.likedLine: A {item} rides well on a pack. Take my word for it, I have thrown out everything that didn't.
wanderer:traveler.dislikeLine: A {item} is weight and nothing else, and weight is what the road takes out of your knees.
wanderer:traveler.politeLine: A {item}. Well. Thank you kindly. It will come as far as the next town at least.
wanderer:traveler.insultLine: I have walked from the far side of the flood-line, and you offer a {item}. Keep it. Keep the road too.

wanderer:refugee.lovedLine: A {item} — truly? For me? We left with what was on our backs and it was not this. I will not forget the face, I promise you that.
wanderer:refugee.likedLine: A {item}. Yes. Yes, that helps. Small things help more than people think.
wanderer:refugee.dislikeLine: Please, no. A {item} draws eyes, and eyes are how the rest of my family was taken.
wanderer:refugee.politeLine: A {item}. That is kind. I have nothing to give back but I will remember it was given.
wanderer:refugee.insultLine: I have lost a house, a village and two brothers, and you hand me a {item}. Go on. Go and find someone with less.

wanderer:tinker.lovedLine: Hold — hold, let me — yes. A {item}. Do you know what I can put back into service with this? Three carts and a pump, and that is before supper.
wanderer:tinker.likedLine: A {item}. Good. Into the roll it goes, third pocket. Everything has a pocket.
wanderer:tinker.dislikeLine: A {item} has no parts in it. If a thing cannot be opened, I have no conversation with it.
wanderer:tinker.politeLine: A {item}. Aye, thank you, set it by the wheel there. I'll get to it.
wanderer:tinker.insultLine: Twenty years mending other people's ruin, and the payment is a {item}. Away with you, I am busy.

wanderer:scout.lovedLine: A {item}. That is the difference between seeing them first and being seen first. I will not thank you loudly, but I am thanking you.
wanderer:scout.likedLine: A {item}. Quiet, light, no shine on it. That's the whole list.
wanderer:scout.dislikeLine: A {item} is loud, or heavy, or bright. I work alone and I intend to keep coming back.
wanderer:scout.politeLine: A {item}. Right. It goes in the cache with the rest and I'll pick it up if I ever need it.
wanderer:scout.insultLine: I range three days ahead of anyone who would help me, and you offer a {item}. Get behind me and stay there.

wanderer:pilgrim.lovedLine: A {item}. Bless you — I have walked barefoot past four shrines to be worthy of a thing like this, and here it is, handed over at a roadside.
wanderer:pilgrim.likedLine: A {item} will see me to the next waystone, and the next waystone is all any of us are promised.
wanderer:pilgrim.dislikeLine: That came out of a tomb. I will not carry a {item} that was taken off the dead; the road is hard enough without owing them.
wanderer:pilgrim.politeLine: A {item}. My thanks. I shall set it down at the shrine and let it choose its own keeper.
wanderer:pilgrim.insultLine: My feet are split to the bone in the service of the walk, and you hand me a {item}. May you find your own road short.

wanderer:drifter.lovedLine: A {item}. That's the first straight dealing I've had in a month of towns. I'll not pretend it isn't worth something to me.
wanderer:drifter.likedLine: A {item}. Fine. It works or it doesn't, and that one works.
wanderer:drifter.dislikeLine: A {item} means somebody owns you. I've been owned. Keep it.
wanderer:drifter.insultLine: I've slept in worse ditches than you've walked past, and a {item} is still an insult. Move along.

wanderer:scavenger.lovedLine: A {item} — that's whole, that is, that's not even cracked. Give it here, give it here before somebody sees us doing this.
wanderer:scavenger.likedLine: A {item}. There's a man two valleys over who buys those and doesn't ask. That'll do me.
wanderer:scavenger.dislikeLine: What am I to do with a {item}? Can't eat it, can't sell it, and wearing it gets a body noticed.
wanderer:scavenger.politeLine: A {item}. Aye. In the sack. It all goes in the sack.
wanderer:scavenger.insultLine: I pull my living out of dead machines with my hands, and you give me a {item}. Don't follow me.

overlay:pavel_allegedly_.lovedLine: A {item}. Do you know what a woman named Hass would forgive for one of these? Do not answer. Do not say her name up here either.
overlay:pavel_allegedly_.likedLine: A {item}, fine, good, I'll take it — half price on anything you want, and you never saw which way I went.
overlay:pavel_allegedly_.dislikeLine: No. Not a {item}. Every one of those has a stamp on it somewhere and stamps are how they find people.
overlay:pavel_allegedly_.politeLine: A {item}. Yes. Thank you. Put it behind the crate, would you, not on top of it.
overlay:pavel_allegedly_.insultLine: A {item}? I am a hunted man, not a beggar — and if I were a beggar I would still say no. Pavel is not even my name.

fallback.lovedLine: {npc} turns the {item} over once and then puts it somewhere safe rather than somewhere convenient. "Thank you. Genuinely."
fallback.likedLine: {npc} weighs the {item} and nods slowly. "That is a good thing to be given. I will not forget who gave it."
fallback.politeLine: {npc} takes the {item} with good grace. It goes under the counter, and you suspect it stays there.
fallback.insultLine: {npc} looks at the {item}, and then at you, for slightly too long. "No. You keep that."
